summary_en.motivation: To compile surgical pearls and pitfalls when converting a failed hip resurfacing to total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A narrative review of surgical techniques based on literature and expert experience.
summary_en.result: Key recommendations are provided for intraoperative management and complication avoidance.
summary_en.validation: No validation; it is a review article.
